description.value: One of Vancouver's oldest community centres, Kerrisdale Community Centre has been operated by the Kerrisdale Community Centre Society since 1943 and celebrated its 80th anniversary in 2023. Its facilities span an indoor pool, exercise room, gymnasium, public library, seniors wing, an ice arena (Cyclone Taylor Arena), and an outdoor pool at nearby Maple Grove. Touring cyclists passing through the Kerrisdale neighbourhood may find the range of recreation facilities useful as a mid-route stop.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (18 spaces) at 34m; stands (4 spaces) at 78m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the centre is actively operating at 5851 West Boulevard, Vancouver, with an indoor pool, exercise room, gymnasium, public library, and seniors wing; the address and phone (604-257-8100) are confirmed on the contact/hours page, though OSM had no phone listed. No explicit mention of bike parking, showers accessible without pool admission, water bottle refill stations, or any cycling-specific amenities was found in the website content, leaving those fields null. The venue is clearly open and operational (Summer 2026 registration news, current program guides), but its primary purpose is serving local residents rather than touring cyclists.
